title: Chicken Broccoli Alfredo
steps:
Boil the pasta 9 min.
Shred the rotisserie
chicken meanwhile

Broccoli into the same
pot for the last 3 min.
Drain, save some water

Back in the pot: Alfredo
+ chicken, toss till hot.
Top with parmesan
vo: Dinner on the table in twenty minutes.
You need a rotisserie chicken, fettuccine, a jar of Alfredo sauce, broccoli and parmesan.
Boil the fettuccine for nine minutes, and shred the rotisserie chicken while it cooks.
Drop the broccoli into the same pot for the last three minutes, then drain, and save a little pasta water.
Back in the pot, add the Alfredo sauce and the chicken, toss until it's hot, and top with parmesan.
